body.x: Sheco Co., Ltd. (CEO Gwon Gisung) participated in CES 2025, held from January 7 to 10 in Las Vegas, under the Incheon IFEZ Pavilion. Sheco specializes in developing water treatment solutions utilizing robotic technologies to automate and optimize water pollution management. With its slogan, “Going Green with Robotics,” the company is committed to delivering innovative technologies that ensure a cleaner environment for present and future generations.

At CES 2025, Sheco introduced its flagship product, the "Sheco Ark-M." This water purification robot is designed to clean polluted water bodies using a horizontal impeller system that directs water and pollutants into a reusable mesh filter. The impurities are collected in a cartridge, and purified water is immediately discharged into the environment.

The Sheco Ark-M is equipped with proprietary impeller and filter technology that effectively separates and collects various pollutants, including oil spills, ship coatings, algal blooms, and cargo dust. Its intuitive controls allow non-experts to operate the robot after 30 minutes of training. With a collection capacity of 30,000 liters per hour and a remote control range of up to 1 km, the Sheco Ark-M stands out for its efficiency and user-friendly design.

body.cap: Sheco representatives demonstrating the water purification solution to AVING News reporter Alex Sigrist at CES 2025. | Photo by AVING News

body.x: The Sheco Ark-M’s focus on affordability, accessibility, safety, versatility, and convenience enables more extensive and independent water management, addressing global water quality challenges. In developed nations, it offers solutions to labor shortages and industrial safety concerns. In developing countries, it overcomes limitations caused by insufficient infrastructure, technology, and capital.

A Sheco representative explained, “Our products are designed to provide efficient solutions across diverse industrial settings and national policies, enhancing the management of water resources worldwide. By participating in CES 2025, we aim to introduce the Sheco Ark-M and our integrated water resource management system to potential global clients facing challenges in water management.”

The company also announced its plans for 2025 and beyond, focusing on integrating hardware with software to enable more extensive water purification, monitoring, and management capabilities. “We envision expanding our solutions to include unified water management systems supported by robotic stations. These advancements could extend beyond public and industrial sectors to incorporate AI-driven smart cities and smart ports,” the representative added.

body.x: AVING News, which has covered CES for 20 consecutive years, continues to support the global ambitions of Korean SMEs and startups through various initiatives.

Before CES 2025, AVING hosted a series of Global Media Meetups featuring aspiring SMEs in Korea. The Meetups introduced Korean SMEs’ technologies, products, and services to media worldwide, expanding connections between the Korean industry and global media. Geekspin, Ubergizmo, Interesting Engineering, and Le Café du Geek participated in these meetups.
During CES 2025, AVING established the AVING Broadcasting Zone at The Venetian Hotel in Las Vegas, interviewing CES Innovation Award 2025 winners.
Following CES 2025, AVING will co-host a review conference with participating companies in Korea, offering them a platform to gain further recognition and enhance their corporate image.
